Cyclone Akvan has begun interacting with the land along the north Andhra Pradesh-south Odisha coast, bringing heavy rainfall and disrupting transport services. More than three lakh people have been evacuated across Odisha, while 423 rescue teams have been deployed. Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi has reviewed preparations under the state's 'Zero Casualty' mission. Railway services have also been disrupted, with dozens of trains cancelled or rescheduled.
